程序包 org.bukkit.event.enchantment

类 EnchantItemEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryEvent
org.bukkit.event.enchantment.EnchantItemEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class EnchantItemEvent extends InventoryEvent implements Cancellable
成功附魔物品的事件 (在附魔台里面附魔的)

原文： Called when an ItemStack is successfully enchanted (currently at enchantment table)

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      获取这个事件是否被取消.一个被取消的事件不会在服务器里执行，但是仍然会传递事件到其他插件.

      原文： Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins

      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      如果事件已经被取消，则为true

      原文：true if this event is cancelled
